name: Suspiratory Chain
text:
A gentle breeze seems to flow through the mesh of this +1 chain mail, which protects against one of the Darklands' signature threats: bad air. You can hold your breath for 10 rounds longer than usual before suffocating, and the armor grants you a +1 item bonus to saving throws against inhaled threats, such as inhaled poisons.

---
Activate—Gasp 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You enter an area where you can't breathe or where breathing would harm you

---
Effect Your armor filters air to you, allowing you to breathe without harm for 10 minutes or until you return to an environment where you can breathe normally.
